items.name: approvals
items.title: Approval inbox
items.description: Everything waiting for a person's yes: pending list, detail with exact inputs and maximum price, Approve and Decline, history, read-only view and a nav badge. Licence: MIT.

items.name: mission-runner
items.title: Mission runner
items.description: Start a mission from a form built from its input schema, see the estimate first, watch its steps live, cancel, and read the result and cost. A run survives a page reload. Licence: MIT.

items.name: assessment
items.title: Assessment
items.description: The builder-side screens for proctored tests: exam list, question builder with preview, publish, invite candidates by link or email, a candidate tracker, results and integrity reports. Candidates take the test on a hosted page their link opens. Licence: MIT.

items.name: wallet
items.title: Wallet and usage
items.description: Balance with a low-balance warning and a top-up button, spend over time and by superpower, and the latest activity with its cost. Money shows as dollars to two decimals. Licence: MIT.

items.name: connections
items.title: Connections manager
items.description: Every connected account in one list: connect an app through the hosted sign-in, land back on a return page that re-checks the status, reconnect, check, disconnect and remove. Also lists your workspace accounts. Licence: MIT.

items.name: memory
items.title: Memory viewer
items.description: What the assistant remembers: search your own memories, delete one, forget everything, see what changed, and (for admins) review organisation memories. Deleting waits for approval in the approvals inbox. Licence: MIT.

items.name: superpower-picker
items.title: Superpower picker
items.description: Find an action or a mission in plain words, answer one clarifying question when the words fit several, see the price, and run an action from a form built from its inputs. Actions that send something wait for a yes in the approvals inbox. Licence: MIT.

items.name: consent
items.title: Consent and opt-out
items.description: Honour STOP and consent: an opt-out list with search, check a contact, add an opt-out, let someone be messaged again (approvers only, recorded), a contact status badge, and a public unsubscribe page. Licence: MIT.

items.name: activity
items.title: Activity log
items.description: What ran, what it cost, and what failed with the next step: a call list filtered by what ran, how it went and dates, a call detail, and a webhook deliveries tab where the API has the history. Falls back to daily totals until the API lists each call. Licence: MIT.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: Take a payment: a button that sends the customer to the hosted payment page for one plan (prices are read on the server), and a status card that says whether it was paid. Licence: MIT.

items.name: payouts
items.title: Seller payments and payouts
items.description: Let a seller set up their own payment account: a status card with what is still needed, and the provider's embedded setup screen. Licence: MIT.

items.name: identity-check
items.title: Identity check
items.description: Verify a person's identity: start a check, show the provider's own screen in the page, then a plain status card with each check's result. Licence: MIT.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A chat with an assistant: replies stream in, the assistant can do things for the person, and anything that needs a yes waits in the approvals inbox before the chat carries on. Licence: MIT.

items.name: account
items.title: Account
items.description: Who is signed in, the organisation's name (owners and admins can change it) and the team with roles and spending limits. Licence: MIT.

items.name: subscriptions
items.title: Subscriptions
items.description: A customer's plan (price, status, renewal date) and a button to the hosted billing page to change their card or cancel. The customer comes from your sign-in, never the browser. Licence: MIT.

items.name: voice-call
items.title: Voice call
items.description: A dialler card for the browser: keypad, number display, calling-from line, in-call timer with mute and hang up, and recent calls with one-click call back. A call waits for a yes in the approvals inbox. Licence: MIT.

items.name: booking
items.title: Booking
items.description: Visitors pick an open time on your own connected calendar and book it. Shows needs connection with a link to connections when the calendar isn't linked. Licence: MIT.

items.name: e-sign
items.title: E-signature
items.description: Send a document to be signed by email, see who has signed, remind the ones who haven't, and open the signed copy. Licence: MIT.

items.name: upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: Drag and drop files, watch each one upload with progress straight to storage, then see, open and delete what you uploaded. Licence: MIT.

items.name: theme
items.title: Pramaan blocks theme
items.description: The Pramaan look: one CSS file of colour, type, radius and dark-mode variables that every block reads, and the three fonts it uses. Import the CSS after Tailwind and put pramaanFonts on <html>. Licence: MIT.

items.name: password-reset
items.title: Password reset
items.description: Request an emailed reset link, choose a new password, and change it while signed in. Licence: MIT.

items.name: contacts
items.title: Contacts
items.description: People and companies with notes and history in your own database. Licence: MIT.

items.name: pipeline
items.title: Pipeline
items.description: Deals and tasks with stage totals and accessible stage moves in your own database. Licence: MIT.
